biotools.summary: ShinyCardinal is an open-source desktop application for mass spectrometry imaging data analysis, covering all steps from data preprocessing to metabolite identification. It leverages the R package Cardinal and provides a user-friendly graphical interface for a stable and consistent data analysis framework.
